message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: two defendants beat victim, victim died due to acute coronary attack triggered by fight, also had nasal bone fractures (light injury). The prosecution says they committed intentional injury causing death, i.e., "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury) leading to death. In Chinese criminal law, causing death by intentional injury is still "故意伤害罪" (if death is result). Could also be "过失致死"? But they acted intentionally to injure, not to kill. So charge is "故意伤害致人死亡" which is still "故意伤害罪". The example earlier: first case had both "故意伤害;虐待". They listed both. Here only "故意伤害". So answer: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>. Need JSON with reasoning and final_answer.

Actually the problem statement: "请你模拟法官依据下面事实给出罪名。请先进行推理分析，然后将最终答案写在[罪名]和<eoa>之间。" So they want final answer inside [罪名] and <eoa>. Example: "- 单个罪名: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>" So final answer should be "[罪名]故意伤害<eoa>". The JSON field final_answer should contain that string.
